scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/rrule/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/ical/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/dom/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/motion-gsap/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/angular/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/angular/tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit
scripts.pack:local: npm run build && rm -rf packed && mkdir packed && for p in rrule core ical dom motion-gsap theme angular; do (cd packages/$p/dist && npm pack --pack-destination ../../../packed >/dev/null); done && ls packed
